codes.predicate: target object or action is ambiguous
falsePositiveCases: a resolved target with optional follow-up work

codes.trigger: scope is missing or exceeds user-directed scope
codes.alternativePath: retain only the explicitly bounded scope

codes.predicate: a required authority source is unreadable
codes.trigger: required source path is missing or invalid
codes.recovery: restore the required source or choose a bounded alternate Profile

codes.predicate: a direct P0 or authorization boundary is violated
codes.trigger: the current action crosses a declared hard boundary
codes.alternativePath: do not execute the violating action
codes.recovery: remove the violating action or obtain the separately required authorization
falsePositiveCases: a claim limitation without an action violation

codes.predicate: the contract is malformed for its validation Profile
codes.trigger: required structural field or scope binding is missing
codes.recovery: repair the contract and re-run structural validation
falsePositiveCases: an optional non-target artifact is absent

codes.predicate: a required SourceRef is stale for this Profile
codes.trigger: snapshot hash differs for a required source
codes.alternativePath: continue only in a Profile that does not depend on the source
codes.recovery: re-read the affected SourceRef and create a new snapshot
falsePositiveCases: stale source outside the current scope

codes.trigger: snapshot hash differs for a non-required source
codes.recovery: refresh only if the Profile later requires it
falsePositiveCases: a required source used by the current Profile

codes.trigger: H/I or other non-core receipt is missing
codes.alternativePath: continue development with a capped claim
codes.recovery: run the bounded Profile that produces the receipt
falsePositiveCases: an acceptance Profile whose target is the missing receipt

codes.alternativePath: continue static work and disclose the missing Runtime proof
codes.recovery: run the explicitly authorized Runtime Profile

codes.trigger: the capability is not required by the selected Profile
codes.alternativePath: continue using the bounded static path
codes.recovery: enable the capability only when separately authorized
falsePositiveCases: a required capability for the selected Profile

codes.predicate: the next read would exceed the declared budget
codes.trigger: bytes, depth, elapsed time, or read count would exceed budget
codes.alternativePath: finish with current evidence or request a bounded budget
codes.recovery: re-plan with an explicit larger budget
falsePositiveCases: a read already completed within the budget

codes.predicate: a second bounded authority domain is required
codes.trigger: core checks identify a declared cross-domain dependency
codes.alternativePath: remain on core with a claim cap if the extension is optional
falsePositiveCases: generic keywords without a declared cross-domain dependency

codes.predicate: the requested Profile is outside core coverage
codes.trigger: the target Profile is explicitly specialized
codes.recovery: select the specialized Profile with its own budget
falsePositiveCases: a core Profile with optional specialized evidence

codes.predicate: a second extension depth is explicitly justified
codes.trigger: a declared reason code authorizes depth two
codes.alternativePath: stop at depth one and cap the claim
codes.recovery: re-plan from the same snapshot with the bounded depth-two reason
